mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in the CPIAUCSL index above 2.0% triggers investor concerns about inflation, prompting central banks to raise interest rates and reducing expected equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not decline significantly (t-test p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL crosses above 2.0.

mechanism_narrative: Rising demand (GDPC1) alongside accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS) creates a synergistic effect, amplifying equity valuation growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: Both GDPC1 and FEDFUNDS increase over the prior 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when both proxies rise simultaneously (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion phase characterized by elevated industrial production (INDPRO) and high housing demand (HOUST), investors anticipate sustained growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > 95 and HOUST > 650 in the same month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns fail to outperform baseline in the regime defined by INDPRO > 95 and HOUST > 650 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained decreases in UNRATE below 5% coupled with rising payroll employment (PAYEMS) signal tight labor markets, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises above 5% or 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite UNRATE decline.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in RSAFS below 350 million signals weakening demand, prompting market expectations of recession and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS crosses below 350 in the prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not decline significantly (t-test p > 0.05) when RSAFS falls below 350.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery phase where FEDFUNDS rise but remain below 2% and industrial production (GDPC1) recovers, investors anticipate prolonged easing, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases but stays below 2% while GDPC1 recovers from prior lows
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns fail to outperform baseline in the regime defined by FEDFUNDS < 2% and GDPC1 recovery (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 demand growth signals robust economic activity, prompting market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite rising GDPC1.
